# Andrew Manson

> Graduating electrical engineering student at the University of British Columbia, Okanagan (UBCO) and open-source developer. I build Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and AI tooling, and work across embedded systems, machine vision, and analog electronics. I like solving real-world problems with simple solutions.

- Website: https://www.jandrewmanson.engineer/
- GitHub: https://github.com/jamubc
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jandrewmanson/
- Email: andrew@jandrewmanson.engineer

## Open-Source & AI Projects

- [Gemini MCP Tool](https://github.com/jamubc/gemini-mcp-tool): MCP server that lets AI assistants interface with the Google Gemini CLI to analyze large-context files and codebases. 2.2k+ GitHub stars. (TypeScript, Node.js)
- [Logic Pro MCP](https://github.com/jamubc/logic-pro-mcp): Experimental MCP for the Logic Pro DAW — AI-generated arrangements, chord progressions, and producer quality-of-life tooling. (Python, AppleScript)
- [Qwen MCP Tool](https://github.com/jamubc/qwen-mcp-tool): MCP server for driving the Qwen CLI and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint for large-context analysis. Published on npm. (TypeScript)
- [2ManyTabs MCP](https://github.com/jamubc/2ManyTabs-MCP): Manage browser tabs (list, group, deduplicate, bulk-close) with natural language from any MCP client; runs locally over loopback. (JavaScript, Chrome Extension, Node.js)
- [Jarvis — Local AI Assistant](https://github.com/jamubc/JarvisAtHome): Fully local, offline voice assistant pipeline (VAD, wake word, Whisper STT, intent matching, TTS). No cloud APIs. (JavaScript, Node.js)
- [Canvas Downloader](https://github.com/jamubc/Canvas_Downloader): Fast, strictly read-only CLI for downloading and organizing Canvas LMS course content. Published on PyPI. (Python)
- [Env Manager TUI](https://github.com/jamubc/env-manager): Terminal environment-variable manager with AES-256-GCM encrypted local storage. (Python, Textual)
- [JamCLI](https://github.com/jamubc/jamcli): Efficient multi-model terminal CLI with Ollama and OpenRouter support. (TypeScript)

## Engineering & Research

- Automated Apple Grade Classification: CNN-based machine-vision grading on a Raspberry Pi, 96% accuracy on a $187 budget. (Python, TensorFlow Lite, OpenCV, Edge ML)
- Analog PPG Heart Rate Monitor: Heart-rate measurement via photoplethysmogram using a multi-stage analog signal filter, validated in LTSpice.
- Automotive engineering: exhaust system repair, rust restoration, and a 4-cylinder engine rebuild (welding, fabrication, mechanical).
